title: Diker-Tishman Professor of Sociology, Emeritus
bio: Christopher Winship is the Diker-Tishman Professor of Sociology, Emeritus in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences and a faculty affiliate in the Harvard Kennedy School. He is a research associate at the Hauser Center for Nonprofit Organizations, the Criminal Justice Program, the Institute for Quantitative Social Science, and a faculty associate of the Science, Technology and Society program. Prior to coming to Harvard in 1992, he was Professor of Sociology, Statistics, and Economics at Northwestern University.
